note: About as close to the stated ICP as the corpus gets. He is a PhD psychologist running his own practice and teaching graduate students — squarely the 'physician or equivalent' profile — and business is steady enough that he turns work down. Income is not in question: he ruled money out himself before price was ever mentioned. Health is the neglected area rather than a crisis; he is 160 lb at 5'8", cycles, does modified CrossFit and tracks his macros, and by his own account 'most 63 year olds I know don't do as well as I do'. The good-to-great framing is his own words — 'I'm ready to take two or three steps bigger than that'. He clearly clears the exclusion: not deconditioned, not gym-averse, already trains before work most days. Two things the stated criteria do not capture and a human should note: he is 63, older than the archetype the ICP describes, and he has a cardiac history (AFib, hereditary heart disease) that the stated ICP has no criterion for at all — the same clinical blind spot already flagged in the ICP observations, showing up here in a prospect who fits perfectly on paper and bought without hesitation.
